title: Leave #Christmas alone!!!! #bible  #history #christian #god #jesus #black #latino #native #fyp #live
segments: Our people always want to give gifts on
so-called Christmas, but we already got
a high holy day where we're supposed
to give gifts when we overcame the
wicked plot of Haman in the time of the
Feast of Purim. Check this out. This is
Esther chapter 9 and verse 21.
To establish this among them, that they
should keep the 14th day of the month of
Adar
>> and the 15th day of the same yearly as
the days wherein the Jews rested
from their enemies and the month which
was turned unto them from sorrow to joy
and from mourning  into a good
day, that they should make them days of
feasting and joy and of sending portions
one to another and gifts to the poor. We
already got a high holy day to
give gifts. The Feast of Purim coming
soon. Shalom.
